basic_info.description: Discover this light-filled single-family home in San Francisco's desirable Parkside District, where charm, flexibility, and modern amenities converge. Upstairs, this inviting residence features three spacious bedrooms and a full bath, with fresh carpet in each bedroom, plus an additional level with a bright den offering serene ocean views. The main living area is anchored by a cozy natural wood-burning fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Downstairs, a flexible floor plan with a separate entrance includes a wet bar, full bath, and an additional room, making it ideal for guests, a home office, or recreation. Step outside to a level, low-maintenance backyard with new landscaping, perfect for outdoor leisure and relaxation, along with the convenience of a 1-car garage. Ideally located near Sunset Boulevard, this home provides easy access to Taraval and Noriega shopping and dining, weekly farmer's markets, scenic Ocean Beach, and local parks. Public transportation, freeway access, SFSU, Stone's Town Galleria, and top-rated Lowell High School are all nearby. Don't miss the opportunity to own a spacious and affordable home in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, where city living meets comfort and convenience.
